input.cmd: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; $s8OsInfo = Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_OperatingSystem; $s8HeavyProcesses = @(Get-Process -ErrorAction Stop | Where-Object { $_.ProcessName -match 'vivado|vitis|verilator|g\+\+|cc1plus|xsim' } | ForEach-Object { @{ pid = $_.Id; name = $_.ProcessName; start_time_utc8 = $_.StartTime.ToString('o'); working_set_bytes = $_.WorkingSet64 } }); @{ observed_at_utc8 = (Get-Date).ToString('o'); total_kib = $s8OsInfo.TotalVisibleMemorySize; free_kib = $s8OsInfo.FreePhysicalMemory; heavy_processes = $s8HeavyProcesses; c_free_bytes = ([System.IO.DriveInfo]::new('C')).AvailableFreeSpace } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 -Compress
input.justification: 在已授权阶段验证前只读核验实际内存、磁盘和现存重型进程，确保 16GB 本机单重型任务。
